# Utility Functions Spec

## Problem Statement

Utility functions need documented behavior so agents can verify correctness.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-1: slugify converts spaces to hyphens and lowercases
- [ ] SC-2: truncate appends ellipsis when string exceeds max length
- [ ] SC-3: capitalize uppercases the first character only
